Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-20270401-789 / bank details

Hi Elena — thanks for sending this over and for including the bank details. A couple of quick asks so we can clear payment: 

- Because you indicate Novus Bio Ltd. is a UK company and you don’t have a US EIN, we will need a completed W-8BEN-E (signed) to document foreign status for tax withholding.
- Please also attach a copy of your company registration (certificate of incorporation) for our vendor file.
- If you believe treaty rates apply (withholding reduction), include the treaty paragraph on the W-8BEN-E and supporting docs.

Cc'ing Marcus (Payments) to confirm timing assumptions. Naomi, can you confirm whether additional fields in the W-8 are typically required for our vendor verification?

If you can attach the W-8 and certificate we can start verification and move the invoice into our payable queue.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Finance Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

Thanks for the docs, Elena. A couple notes from Payments: 

- We'll start vendor setup in the AP system once legal confirms the W-8 copy is sufficient. Expect a short verification window (2–3 business days).
- Payment schedule: Redwood issues BACS/Wire payments on the 3rd and 18th of each month for international vendors; given timing we'll target release on 2027-04-18. If you need earlier, we can investigate an exception but will need approvals.
- Please send a scanned copy of the bank account holder's passport or a bank confirmation letter (to confirm remittance name matches vendor). This is standard for non-US payees receiving wires.

Thanks — I'll mark the invoice as "pending verification" in the AP tracker.

Marcus Lin
Payments Manager
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-20270401-789 / bank details

Elena — thanks for the prompt turnaround. I reviewed the W-8BEN-E and certificate. A couple requests to close the vendor file: 

- The W-8 has a handwritten signature and a date; can you provide the printed name and capacity of the signatory (e.g., "Elena Martinez, Finance Manager"). If the signatory is not the beneficial owner, we need a capacity statement.
- For our records, please confirm whether Novus Bio has a US tax reporting agent or US-based affiliate. If you do, include their name and EIN.
- The certificate of incorporation is good; please confirm the registered address used on the W-8 matches the certificate.

Once we have those clarifications, legal will clear and payments can proceed. If Novus prefers, we can accept a scanned passport copy (redact passport number) for the remittance name confirmation Marcus requested.

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
